T1.decisionReason: The coffee texture is warm, but the long open overshirt, large patch pocket, backpack and visible base tee create a daytime utility look rather than an intentional Spring Date focal top.

T2.decisionReason: The saturated green could be joyful, but the hanger-only source proves no shoulder, torso, sleeve or hem behavior and the shiny crinkled cloth looks inexpensive.

T3.decisionReason: The washed blue is pleasant, but the long open body, dark base tee and two large flap pockets create a practical utility overshirt rather than a refined Date layer.

T4.decisionReason: The light-blue rib is attractive, but the narrow sleeves, tight shoulder and heavily bunched long torso reproduce the skinny-top problem.

T5.decisionReason: The dark-brown polo has reasonable ease, but oversized bright buttons, bunched sleeves and flat near-black color make it feel cheap and joyless for Spring Date Night.

T6.decisionReason: The clean texture is usable, but the dropped shoulder and broad long T-shirt body are too generic and casual to anchor an intentional Mid-Range date outfit.

B1.decisionReason: The isolated light-gray trouser hides rise, seat, length and break while diagonal knee seams and synthetic wrinkles read technical rather than tailored.

B2.decisionReason: Warm ivory is ideal, but this flat denim packshot does not prove rise, thigh ease, length or shoe break, so it cannot support a visual outfit approval.

B3.decisionReason: The medium-blue jean has a broad leg visibly folding and stacking over the sneaker, recreating the uncontrolled baggy-bottom problem.

B4.decisionReason: The unworn olive trouser is shiny and wrinkled with novelty bead hardware; neither drape nor Date refinement is proven.

B5.decisionReason: The exposed black drawstring, gathered waist, crinkled lounge cloth and puddled hem make this a leisure pant rather than a polished date trouser.

B6.decisionReason: The dirty acid yellow-green wash, very broad streetwear leg and heavy hem collapse are visually noisy and uncontrolled.

O1.decisionReason: The sky blue is cheerful, but the thin rumpled cloth, rolled cuffs, patch chest pocket and casual jeans styling make the jacket look improvised rather than refined.

O2.decisionReason: The blazer is extremely long and boxy with overlong sleeves, low patch pockets and flat thin fabric; it would overwhelm a controlled date silhouette.

O3.decisionReason: The white blazer has a usable idea, but its washed thin surface, bunched sleeves and generic patch-pocket construction do not visually justify a Mid-Range Date hold.

O4.decisionReason: The close waist and sleeves plus heavy green, burgundy, black and cream stripes create a fitted retro costume rather than current Zara-led romance.

O5.decisionReason: The controlled hip-length shacket can serve a unique Fall Date outfit, but its mottled faux leather, dark taupe color and hardware are too heavy for this fresh Spring palette.

O6.decisionReason: The trench belongs in Rainy Day or Travel; its very dropped shoulder, extra-long body and streetwear volume would swallow this Date silhouette.
